show_SMPL_cameraView: render SMPL mesh in camera view mode and optionally save the rendered output to a file
setSkeleton: set skeleton joint data with a specified joint type like smplcoco or spin for 3D visualization
setMeshData: set 3D mesh vertex and face data with optional normal computation for OpenGL rendering
render_on_image: render a 3D scene overlaid on a background image and save the result to a file
VisSkeleton_single: visualize a single frame skeleton by setting joint data and launching the OpenGL viewer
